title: Cathode-Ray Tube
description: Simulate CPU cycles to compute signal strengths and render CRT pixels.
writeup:
## Approach

Simulate a CPU with a single register `X` and two instructions: `noop` (1 cycle) and `addx V` (2 cycles, then adds V to X). Track the cycle count and register value together.

## Part 1

Sum `cycle × X` at cycles 20, 60, 100, 140, 180, 220. The key is that the signal is sampled *during* the cycle, before `addx` takes effect.

## Part 2

Draw a 40×6 CRT. Each cycle, if the current pixel column is within ±1 of X (the sprite center), draw `#`, otherwise `.`. The register X acts as the horizontal sprite position.
